g1-implement.title: G1 car-prior envelope: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G1. Build the canonical car-capability ceiling as-of weekend W: a new physics-region module src/physics/utilization/car_prior.py that, given the EstimateStore rows for (year, constructor) and a target round W, (a) evaluates the cross-session drift-pooled five-view scalars CAUSALLY through-W (a new causal as-of predict, NOT the existing symmetric DriftFit.predict that leaks future sessions; expose a strictly-pre-W slice too), (b) assembles them into a PhysicsParameterSet + propagated covariance via the bridge (cda_closed->theta_D=CdA/(2*MASS), coast_theta_R->theta_R, p_max->power curve, a_b/b_b->BrakingParameters, a_t/b_t->TractionParameters, A0/A2->LateralParameters; ceiling absent in store -> the per-car Gsat fallback per decision ideal_lap_sim_two_sided_evaluator), and (c) wraps it via CapabilityEnvelope.from_parameters (the CANONICAL ideal-lap path; do NOT add a second inline scalar sim). Honest covariance: pooled sigma -> envelope covariance. Validate inputs (name field/expectation/actual). Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-implementer. Wait for and integrate the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g2-implement.title: G2 per-regime utilization: implement
g2-implement.imperative: Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF for G2. Build src/physics/utilization/regime_utilization.py: given the G1 car envelope (+covariance), a driver's realised best quali lap (speed trace) and the session ribbon, simulate the ideal lap (PhysicsSimulator) and compute DRIVER UTILIZATION decomposed per regime (slow corner / fast corner / braking / straight) = realised-vs-ceiling, normalised to compare across circuits/cars, with covariance propagated from envelope covariance + lap sampling. Reuse src/physics/sim_evaluator.py Delta-v helpers (delta_v_profile, braking_zone_delta_v, resample_by_progress); add the slow/fast-corner split (by downforce-loading v^2*kappa / apex-speed threshold; settle the threshold as a named constant) and the straight partition; ensure the four regime masks tile the lap. The car/driver split is acknowledged impure (joint observation) -> covariance owns it; do NOT over-claim separation. Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-implementer. Wait for and integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

triage_candidates.statement: Upgrade the car-prior development clock from round_idx to the FIA upgrade_clock (src/physics/layer2/upgrades.py) when upgrades.yaml is reliably present, so step_var means drift-per-upgrade (de-aliases development from circuit). Causal ordering is preserved either way; this only changes the drift-rate magnitude/units. Endorsed by G1 review.

Add a proper pooled 2x2 covariance for car_prior (requires a pooled-blob in the estimate store schema or per-session-blob combination in car_prior), plus an explicit fallback_channels: list[str] field on CarCeilingResult so G2 consumers can tell which channels used config defaults vs pooled values (as_of_means['A2'] is populated even on A0/A2 fallback). Endorsed by G1 review.

Expose a public PhysicsSimulator.monte_carlo_speed_profiles() returning per-point speed-profile distributions, so regime_utilization's covariance MC stops reaching into the private _sample_parameters; monte_carlo_laps today returns lap times only. Endorsed by G2 review.
Add a regime_utilization re-export to src/physics/utilization/__init__.py for consistency with car_prior (small reconcile-time fix; Cartographer candidate).

Refine U_r from equal-point mean-of-ratios to a distance- or time-weighted integral (a longer corner should weigh more than a short one); first characterization uses mean-of-ratios which meets the frontier/0.9 invariants. Endorsed by G2 review.

Make the MC seed a named config field (PhysicsEstimatorConfig) so production estimate_driver_utilization calls are reproducible without caller-side seed threading. Also consider sharing CURVATURE_THRESHOLD between regime_utilization and the simulator's PhysicsEstimatorConfig to prevent drift. Endorsed by G2 review.

C1 HEADLINE FINDING (reachback): the car-prior ceiling systematically UNDER-CALLS braking + fast-corner capability (U clips at 2.0 for all 10 subset cases; slow-corner also U>1). Root cause = the known braking-knee under-call (decision:smoother_rounds_braking_knee / #496 outer-loop). Braking + fast-corner utilization is NOT usable until the ceiling is recalibrated. Post this on #510 and #496; this is the clean-quali-anchor reachback the spec flagged. Confirmed by G3 review via code-reading (genuine under-call, not a characterize bug).

Cleanup commit: the single-path retirement left scripts/ideal_lap_compare.py + scripts/ideal_vs_actual.py as RuntimeError stubs AND broke scripts/ver_monza_kde.py (still imports sim_lap/_params/build_track/field_drivers from the retired ideal_lap_compare). Delete the two stubs and repair-or-retire ver_monza_kde.py (it depended on the now-retired inline sim). No live src/tests consumers.
Dashboard: add a clip-detection warning that flags regimes where >=50% of cases hit U_CLIP_MAX, so the ceiling under-call is visible to consumers of the readout.

Characterization runtime: each case reloads the full FastF1 session (~60s). Add a per-GP session cache (load once, reuse across drivers in the same GP) to cut the bounded run from ~663s to ~100-200s and enable larger sweeps.
